faq.title: Ritual Guide
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our formulations, usage, and orders.

items.q: Can I use the Aura Glow Concentrate every day?
items.a: Yes. Our THD Ascorbate form of Vitamin C is the most photo-stable form available and is formulated for twice-daily use on clean, dry skin without irritation — even for sensitive skin types.

items.q: How long until I see visible results?
items.a: Most clients report improved luminosity and smoother texture within 10–14 days. Clinical outcomes for hyperpigmentation and barrier repair typically emerge between 4–8 weeks of consistent use.

items.q: Are the products suitable for sensitive skin?
items.a: All formulas are dermatologist-tested and free from sulfates, parabens, synthetic fragrances, and INCI-listed allergens. The Silk Radiance Cleanser is especially recommended for reactive and sensitized skin types.

items.q: In what order should I apply the products?
items.a: Morning: (1) Silk Radiance Cleanser → (2) Aura Glow Concentrate → (3) Luminous Dew Layer. Evening: replace the moisturizer with Celestial Recovery Mask twice weekly. Always finish with SPF in the morning.

items.q: Do you ship outside of Portugal?
items.a: We ship within the European Union with complimentary standard delivery on orders above €75. Express and international shipping options are available at checkout.

items.q: What is your return and exchange policy?
items.a: We accept returns of unopened, sealed products within 30 days of delivery. Opened products may be eligible for exchange in the event of a verified adverse skin reaction. Contact our concierge team to initiate a return.
